Flow.description:
Fundraising Quick Start: fires synchronously on GC insert and on any update where FQS_Restriction_Release_Date__c changes, then delegates to FQS_Recalculate_GC_FulfillmentType. Runs in the caller transaction so the recalculated FulfillmentType lands in the same commit.
Bulkification: bypassed for callers who hold the FQS_Bypass_Automation custom permission (assigned via the FQS Bypass Automation permset). Data-migration and Data Loader jobs should assume that permset for their running user so multi-thousand-record inserts/updates don't multiply this flow's work into their transaction. After migration, run scripts/apex/fqs-recalc-gc-fulfillmenttype.apex to bring FulfillmentType current on every GC.
Rule (implemented in the subflow): Conditional if any child GDD has FQS_Restriction_Type__c NOT equal to "Without Donor Restriction" (Purpose, Permanent, or Earned Revenue) OR FQS_Restriction_Release_Date__c is populated (any date, past or future); otherwise Unconditional. Clearing the release date is what flips a release-date-only Conditional back to Unconditional — hence the ISCHANGED entry filter on that field. Subflow is idempotent — no recursion risk when it writes back to the GC.
Flow.label: FQS GC Fulfillment On Change

subflows.label: Call Recalculate
subflows.description: Delegates fulfillment-type recalculation to the shared subflow, passing the current record's Id.
